blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY, Philippines — A refill vending machine designed to reduce plastic waste, particularly single-use sachets, was pilot-tested along Session Road recently as part of efforts to encourage the use of reusable containers. In a statement on Tuesday (Nov. 3), the Baguio City Public Information Office said the machine, developed under the Circuflow, or Circuit Flow project, was introduced during the city’s Ecological Waste Fair last month. It was developed by Chief Commercial Officer Timothy Dave Eming, Chief Operations Officer Leandro Rey Gepila, and Chief Executive Officer Engr. Sean Empizo.
